cards.english_title: Lee Wants One Cybersecurity Boss After New Attacks
cards.korean_desc: 이재명 대통령은 2026년 11월 3일 제안했다. 그는 기존 체계가 공격 뒤 대응한다고 말했다. 한국은 SK텔레콤, 쿠팡과 금융기관에서 침해를 겪었다.
cards.english_desc: President Lee Jae Myung proposed a powerful cybersecurity coordinator on November 3, 2026. He said existing systems focus too much on inspections and responses after attacks. South Korea has suffered breaches at SK Telecom, Coupang, banks and financial institutions.
cards.hook: Lee wants one cyber boss after cyberattacks.
cards.takeaway_english: The plan matters, but its real test will be authority, speed and clear responsibility.

why_it_matters.english: Cyberattacks can threaten personal data, financial services and everyday digital life.
Companies may spend valuable time answering overlapping demands instead of sharing threats.
why_it_matters.korean: 기업은 위협 공유보다 중복 신고에 시간을 쓸 수 있다.

parties.label: 이재명
parties.english: He wants stronger prevention and one coordinator across public and private sectors.

parties.label: South Korean companies
parties.english: They face attacks while reporting to several authorities under different laws.

parties.label: Cybersecurity officials
parties.english: They must decide whether to improve the current system or create a new agency.

views.label: Lee Jae Myung and supporters
views.english: Existing response-focused systems have clear limits as attacks become more advanced.
views.korean: 공격이 발전해 기존 대응체계는 한계가 있다.

views.label: A former cybersecurity agency official
views.english: A dedicated civilian agency may work better than one massive control tower.
views.korean: 민간 전담기관이 더 나을 수 있다.

disagree.english: Critics may say divided authority slows action, while supporters may fear a new agency will duplicate work.
disagree.korean: 비판자들은 늦은 대응을, 지지자들은 중복을 걱정한다.

cards.source_title: Lee calls for 'cybersecurity czar' amid wave of cyberattacks

views.label: Supporters of a central agency
views.english: One authority could share threat information and coordinate faster across finance, government and industry.
views.korean: 한 기관이 여러 분야를 빠르게 조정할 수 있다.

views.label: Cybersecurity industry official
views.english: A huge control tower could create another layer of bureaucracy instead of stronger defenses.
views.korean: 큰 통합기구가 관료주의를 더할 수 있다.

caption_lines: The Binance theft was blamed on North Korean hackers by the FBI.

cards.english_title: Imported Car Sales Jump as EVs Near Half the Market
cards.korean_desc: 한국은 2026년 10월 수입차 31,117대를 등록했다. 전기차는 46.4%, 하이브리드는 45.9%였다. 테슬라는 9,165대, BYD는 1,594대를 팔았다. 테슬라는 9개월 연속 수입차 1위였다.
cards.english_desc: South Korea registered 31,117 imported vehicles in October 2026. Electric vehicles made up 46.4 percent, just ahead of hybrids at 45.9 percent. Tesla sold 9,165 cars, while BYD Korea sold 1,594. Tesla remained the best-selling imported brand for nine straight months.
cards.takeaway_english: October showed imported-car growth, but supply shortages still shaped the leaderboard.

why_it_matters.english: Electric cars already represented almost half of imported registrations.
why_it_matters.korean: 전기차가 수입차 등록의 거의 절반을 차지했다.

why_it_matters.english: Chinese and American brands gained space beside German automakers.
why_it_matters.korean: 중국과 미국 브랜드가 독일 업체와 경쟁했다.

parties.label: Tesla
parties.english: It sold 9,165 cars and stayed Korea’s top imported passenger-car brand.

parties.label: BYD Korea
parties.english: Its sales rose 93.4 percent to 1,594 vehicles.

parties.label: Korean car buyers
parties.english: They chose electric and hybrid models for most imported-car registrations.

views.label: KAIDA
views.english: Strong EV demand drove the yearly increase, although supply shortages reduced Tesla’s monthly sales.
views.korean: 전기차 수요가 증가를 이끌었지만 공급 부족이 있었다.

views.label: Business Korea
views.english: EVs and hybrids together reached 92 percent of October’s imported-car market.

disagree.english: Some may see a lasting change in demand, while others may see one month shaped by supply and model availability.
disagree.korean: 장기 변화인지 공급과 차종 영향인지 의견이 갈릴 수 있다.

cards.korean_title: 드라마 붐 뒤의 고된 제작 현실
cards.english_title: K-Drama Success Hides Exhausting Work Behind the Scenes
cards.korean_desc: 한빛센터는 10월 24일 주 54시간을 발표했다. 업계는 외주팀에 의존하며 방영 중 촬영한다. 야간근무는 24.8%였고 31%는 11시간도 못 쉬었다. 전문가들은 명확한 계약과 일정 기준이 필요하다고 말했다.
cards.english_desc: A Hanbit study released October 24 found Korean drama crews averaged 54 hours weekly. The sector relies on outsourced teams and often films while episodes are airing. Night shifts made up 24.8 percent, and 31 percent had less than eleven hours’ rest. Experts say clearer contracts and scheduling standards are still needed.
cards.hook: K-dramas are booming, but crews are working too long.
cards.takeaway_english: Korean dramas may need stronger labor standards to match their global reputation.
cards.takeaway_korean: 한국 드라마는 명성에 맞는 노동기준이 필요하다.

why_it_matters.english: Long shifts and short rest can affect worker safety and health.
why_it_matters.korean: 장시간 근무와 짧은 휴식은 안전과 건강에 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: The way dramas are made can shape whether global growth lasts.
why_it_matters.korean: 제작 방식은 세계적 성장이 계속될지 좌우할 수 있다.

parties.label: Drama crews
parties.english: They face long hours, night shifts, short rest and insecure project contracts.

parties.label: Production companies
parties.english: They work through several outsourced layers with few common standards.
parties.korean: 여러 외주 단계에서 공통 기준이 부족하다.

parties.label: Viewers
parties.english: They enjoy global dramas whose production workers may not share the success equally.
parties.korean: 세계적 드라마를 보지만 노동자는 같은 성공을 누리지 못할 수 있다.

views.label: Labor-rights researchers
views.english: The industry’s global success has not kept pace with safe schedules, fair contracts or adequate pay.
views.korean: 세계적 성공이 안전한 일정과 공정한 계약으로 이어지지 않았다.

views.label: Industry observers
views.english: Conditions have improved gradually, especially since the 52-hour workweek began.

disagree.english: The evidence shows real pressure, but the study covers limited workers and may not represent every production.
disagree.korean: 조사 규모가 작아 모든 제작 현장을 대표하지 않을 수 있다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 온라인 플랫폼도 제작 환경에 더 책임져야 할까요?

people.korean: 동시 제작과 방영이 마감시간을 줄인다고 말했다.

people.label: Producer Thomas Suh
people.english: He said the 52-hour framework has clarified expectations about working time.
people.korean: 주 52시간제가 노동시간 기준을 분명히 했다고 말했다.

cards.english_title: Paddack Takes the Ball After Two Taxing Starts
cards.korean_desc: 삼성 투수 크리스 패덕은 2026년 11월 4일 선발이다. 그는 지난주까지 사흘 휴식 선발이 없었다. 그는 5⅓이닝 동안 99구로 기아를 1실점 막았다. 삼성은 화요일 KT에 1차전을 8-7로 졌다.
cards.english_desc: Samsung Lions pitcher Chris Paddack is scheduled for Korean Series Game 2 on November 4, 2026. He had never started on three days’ rest before last week’s playoff game. He held Kia to one run on six hits across 5⅓ innings with 99 pitches. Samsung lost Game 1 to KT Wiz 8-7 on Tuesday.
cards.hook: Paddack will start after two exhausting outings.
cards.takeaway_english: The Lions are betting on preparation, momentum and one tired but willing right arm.
cards.takeaway_korean: 삼성은 준비와 흐름, 지친 오른팔에 기대를 건다.

why_it_matters.english: His outing could influence the Korean Series after Samsung lost a close opener.
why_it_matters.korean: 삼성이 접전 끝에 1차전을 져 그의 등판이 중요하다.

why_it_matters.english: The matchup brings Paddack face-to-face with KT’s leading hitter.

parties.label: Chris Paddack
parties.english: He accepted a Game 2 start on four days’ rest after a demanding playoff week.
parties.korean: 힘든 포스트시즌 뒤 나흘 휴식으로 선발한다.

parties.label: Samsung Lions
parties.english: They need his experience after losing the opener to KT Wiz.

parties.label: KT Wiz
parties.english: Their lineup combines power hitters with disciplined contact hitters.
parties.korean: 장타자와 선구안 좋은 타자들이 함께 있다.

views.label: Paddack
views.english: He feels prepared physically and mentally and wants to seize the championship opportunity.
views.korean: 몸과 마음을 준비했고 우승 기회를 잡고 싶어 한다.

views.label: A cautious view
views.english: Four days’ rest is better than three, but it is not ideal after two taxing outings.
views.korean: 나흘 휴식은 낫지만 두 번의 강한 등판 뒤 이상적이지 않다.

disagree.english: Fans may value his commitment, while medical and coaching concerns remain about workload and recovery.
disagree.korean: 팬들은 투혼을 반기지만 피로와 회복을 걱정할 수 있다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 짧은 회복 뒤 패덕을 선발로 내보낼까요?

cards.english_title: BABYMONSTER Reaches 100 Million Views in Just 11 Days
cards.korean_desc: 이는 그룹의 19번째 1억뷰 영상이다. 디지털 싱글은 10월 23일 일곱 명 중 여섯 명이 불렀다. 베이비몬스터의 춤 투어는 토요일 방콕에서 재개된다.

cards.hook: BABYMONSTER’s video reached 100 million views in 11 days.
cards.takeaway_english: The number is huge, but the next test is whether viewers stay for the tour and music.
cards.takeaway_korean: 큰 숫자 다음 시험은 투어와 음악의 지속력이다.

why_it_matters.english: The group’s video success shows how quickly K-pop releases can travel online.
why_it_matters.korean: 그룹의 성공은 케이팝이 온라인에서 빠르게 퍼짐을 보여준다.

why_it_matters.english: The tour will carry the song to more Asian and Oceanian cities.
why_it_matters.korean: 투어는 이 노래를 아시아와 오세아니아에 더 알릴 것이다.

parties.label: BABYMONSTER
parties.english: The two-year-old group now has 19 music videos above 100 million views.

parties.label: YG Entertainment
parties.english: It released “Deserve” as a digital single on October 23.

parties.label: Fans
parties.english: They helped push the video to a fast milestone before the group’s Asian tour resumes.
parties.korean: 아시아 투어 재개 전에 빠른 기록을 만들었다.

views.label: YG Entertainment
views.english: The milestone shows strong attention for the group’s latest release.
views.korean: 이번 기록은 신곡에 큰 관심이 있음을 보여준다.

views.label: A cautious view
views.english: View counts measure attention, but they do not alone explain why people watched.
views.korean: 조회수만으로 시청 이유를 모두 설명할 수 없다.

disagree.english: Fans may see the number as proof of popularity, while others may want broader measures of success.
disagree.korean: 팬들은 인기를 보지만 다른 사람들은 다른 성공 기준을 원할 수 있다.

cards.english_title: Trump Plans to End Annual Aid While Arms Sales Continue
cards.korean_desc: 그는 지원이 끝나도 무기 판매는 계속된다고 말했다. 이스라엘 야당은 안보에 위험한 변화라고 말했다. 미 의회가 결정하며 현 협정은 2028년까지다.
cards.english_desc: He said arms sales would continue even after the aid ends. Israel’s opposition called the possible change dangerous for national security. Congress will have major influence, and the current agreement runs through 2028.
cards.hook: The US plans to stop $4 billion in annual aid.
cards.takeaway_english: The announcement is important, but Congress will decide whether the promised change becomes policy.
cards.takeaway_korean: 발표는 중요하지만 실제 정책은 의회가 결정한다.

why_it_matters.english: The change could affect Israel’s defense budget and American defense companies.
why_it_matters.korean: 변화는 이스라엘 국방예산과 미국 방산업체에 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: It could reshape a security relationship built over decades.
why_it_matters.korean: 수십 년 된 안보 관계가 달라질 수 있다.

parties.label: United States
parties.english: It plans to stop annual aid in 2027 but continue selling weapons.

parties.label: Israel
parties.english: It has discussed reducing dependence on American aid over time.
parties.korean: 미국 지원 의존을 점차 줄이는 방안을 논의했다.

parties.label: US Congress
parties.english: Congress will have major influence over whether and how the change happens.
parties.korean: 지원 변화의 여부와 방식에 큰 권한이 있다.

views.label: Trump and supporters
views.english: Israel can buy American weapons directly instead of receiving the money as aid.
views.korean: 이스라엘은 지원금 대신 미국 무기를 직접 살 수 있다.

views.label: Israeli opposition
views.english: A sudden aid change could weaken security while Israel faces wars on several fronts.
views.korean: 갑작스러운 변화는 여러 전선의 안보를 약화할 수 있다.

disagree.english: The plan sounds immediate, but Congress and the current agreement could delay or reshape it.
disagree.korean: 계획은 즉시처럼 보이지만 의회와 기존 협정이 바꿀 수 있다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 군사 지원을 무기 판매로 바꿔야 할까요?
